title: Makrofon DB Baureihe 628.ogg
author: MdE (German Wikipedia user), own recording
subject: Makrofon (two-tone horn) of a DB class 628 diesel multiple unit, recorded first outside, then inside the train
attribution: Makrofon of a DB class 628 by MdE, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
share_alike: This file and any edited version of it stay under CC BY-SA 3.0. That does not extend to the rest of the game.
processing: None: the original file, renamed. VehicleHorn plays only the outside take (MAKROFON_START / MAKROFON_LENGTH) with a 120 ms runtime fade-out.
limitations: Not auditioned by the agent. Where the outside take ends is assumed (about the first half) until tuned by ear. Used for every non-steam motorised rail vehicle, not only class 628.
